title: Embedded C¹ submanifolds are Borel sets
statement: Let m, N ∈ ℕ and let S ⊆ ℝ^N satisfy IsC1Submanifold m S: each y ∈ S has open V ⊆ ℝᵐ, open W ∋ y and φ : ℝᵐ → ℝ^N that is C¹ and injective on V, with φ(V) = W ∩ S, V ∩ φ⁻¹(K) compact for every compact K ⊆ W, and Dφ(v) injective for v ∈ V. Then S is a Borel (measurable) subset of ℝ^N.
lean_statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))), IsC1Submanifold m S → MeasurableSet S
